content:
It's time to look at the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases. Pre-orders for Apple's newest offerings officially kicked off this morning, and a number of big-name brands are ready to go. Apple has silicone cases in a range of colors and all-new TechWoven styles, plus the long-time favorite third-party options. From a brand new burgundy option with a built-in stand, to ultra-grippy customizable models, to industry-leading leather from the likes of Nomad and Burton Goods, there's something for everyone. We also have affordable options from brands like Spigen starting at $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Featured Pick: ESR

ESR's brand new lineup of iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories has arrived, offering premium color options, patented technology, and more. The star of the show is the all-new Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case, featuring a built-in zinc-alloy Flex stand integrated into a camera bump protector, offering 3x military-grade protection with a "soft, elastic touch that feels comfortable to hold." The all-new Atelier series, like the rest of the accessories, comes in four color options to perfectly match the new Burgundy, Glacial, Black, and Silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case with Flex Stand $42 (was $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock MagSafe Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo MagSafe Wallet Stand (with Grip) $46 (was $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

Nomad is one of the top-tier brands for leather cases, and their full lineup of best models are now ready for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. This year the brand has also launched an all-new Rugged Case series, each color featuring topographical patterns from Baja California:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Grey
  • Modern Leather Case $69 to $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 to $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colors: Rustic Brown

Featured Pick: Dbrand

Dbrand is ready to go with its acclaimed Grip case for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. In addition to offering one of the cleanest designs on the market and an extremely grippy texture, it once again plays nicely with the wide array of customizable skins, letting you put your personal stamp on things; there's also a discount on the compatible Prism screen protector when you add one.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $55 Customizable, drop-protected, ultra-grippy, great button feel
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) 2-pack $35 ($5 off with case purchase) Easy install, auto-align, zero dust

This year Dbrand is also launching an all-new MNML brand of cases starting at $39, delivering minimalist, stylish designs at an affordable price point, with MagSafe support and the same snappy button feel the brand is known and loved for.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Marine, Tan, Burgundy

  • Full Leather Case (iPhone 18 Series) $59

Burton Goods

***NOTE: The cases below use our exclusive promo code 9TO520 for an additional 20% off the already discounted launch price (saves you 20%). If the code doesn't work, try DUO10 at checkout.

  • Luxury Pocket Book Wallet Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $89 (was $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Duo) $60 (was $80)

UAG

UAG has also launched a number of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including the usual tough-and-durable models with reinforced corner protection, grippy frames, and several drop-proof designs. If you're looking for a case built for harsh environments as well as everyday protection, UAG's lineup is well worth a look.

  • UAG Mouve (iPhone Duo) $65
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case (iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max) $80
  • UAG Civilian Anti-slip Case from $60
  • More...

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Case

If you want to kit out your new iPhone with a rugged case but don't want to go with the usual suspects like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut range is well worth a look. These cases meet MIL-STD-810H drop testing, offer reliable protection, support MagSafe, and come with a built-in rotating kickstand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're on the hunt for a premium iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max case that doesn't add too much bulk, look no further than Mous. Mous now offers its super-thin Aramid Fibre case designed specifically for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, along with the other models below.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fibre Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mous Thin Aramid Fibre Case $70
  • More...

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases are known for their avant-garde designs, futuristic styling, and slim profiles, standing out from the crowd with textural finishes that offer something unique among the usual case options.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-thin Aramid Fibre Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case (iPhone 18 Pro) $60
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are ideal for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users seeking the ultimate in slim design. Their products are typically made from lightweight Aramid fibre, offering a clean, understated look while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and providing extra protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Woven Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop Protection Aramid Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protective Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also has a wide selection of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, ranging from slim everyday models to rugged, heavy-duty designs that offer reliable protection. Many of the newer models support MagSafe, and some come with additional features like more grippy sides, accessory slots, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, giving you the flexibility to choose based on your desired thickness and level of protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series (with Stand) $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • More...

Belkin

Belkin is another solid option for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, especially for users looking for a minimalist design that won't bulk up the phone and who don't need to go with a fully rugged case. Their lineup generally includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised edges around the screen and camera, and some models like the Protect+ feature reinforced corners, striking a nice balance between everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2-compatible MagSafe Case (with Grip) $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case (with Airbag Corners) $60
